overview: A secure, responsive Admin Analytics Dashboard for the AI Studio app, showing real user, AI generation, and subscription statistics with per-feature usage, user management, CSV export, and dark/light sidebar UI.
features: Real dashboard cards for users, activity, generations, and subscriptions
User analytics charts for 7/30/90-day ranges with date filters
Searchable user table with per-user detail pages
CSV export of analytics and user data
Revenue, costs and profit sections with 'Not connected' states
Dark/light mode and responsive mobile design
